// Fast I/O
struct FastIO {
    char buf[8192];
    int pos, len;
    bool needFlush;
    char output_buf[8192];
    int output_pos;
    
    FastIO() : pos(0), len(0), needFlush(false), output_pos(0) {}
    
    char getChar() {
        if (pos >= len) {
            len = fread(buf, 1, sizeof(buf), stdin);
            pos = 0;
            if (len == 0) return EOF;
        }
        return buf[pos++];
    }
    
    void putChar(char c) {
        if (output_pos >= sizeof(output_buf)) {
            fwrite(output_buf, 1, output_pos, stdout);
            output_pos = 0;
        }
        output_buf[output_pos++] = c;
    }
    
    void flush() {
        if (output_pos > 0) {
            fwrite(output_buf, 1, output_pos, stdout);
            output_pos = 0;
        }
        fflush(stdout);
    }
    
    ~FastIO() {
        flush();
    }
} io;

int readInt() {
    int x = 0, c;
    bool neg = false;
    while ((c = io.getChar()) >= 0 && isspace(c));
    if (c == '-') { neg = true; c = io.getChar(); }
    do { x = (x << 3) + (x << 1) + (c & 15); } while ((c = io.getChar()) >= 0 && isdigit(c));
    return neg ? -x : x;
}

string readString() {
    string s;
    int c;
    while ((c = io.getChar()) >= 0 && isspace(c));
    do { s += c; } while ((c = io.getChar()) >= 0 && !isspace(c));
    return s;
}

    char s[20];

}

// AVL Tree implementation
class TreeNode {
public:
    int key;
    int value;
    TreeNode* left;
    TreeNode* right;
    TreeNode* parent;
    int height;
    int num_left;
    int num_total;
    
    TreeNode(int k, int v) : key(k), value(v), left(nullptr), right(nullptr), parent(nullptr),
                              height(1), num_left(1), num_total(1) {}
};

class AvlTree {
private:
    TreeNode* _tree;
    
    static int getHeight(TreeNode* x) {
        return x ? x->height : 0;
    }
    
    static int getNumTotal(TreeNode* x) {
        return x ? x->num_total : 0;
    }
    
    static bool isLeft(TreeNode* node) {
        return node->parent && node->parent->left == node;
    }
    
    static bool isLeaf(TreeNode* node) {
        return node->left == nullptr && node->right == nullptr;
    }
    
    static TreeNode* getNext(TreeNode* node) {
        if (!node->right) return node->parent;
        TreeNode* n = node->right;
        while (n->left) n = n->left;
        return n;
    }
    
    void rotateRight(TreeNode* node) {
        if (!node->parent) {
            _tree = node->left;
            node->left->parent = nullptr;
        } else if (isLeft(node)) {
            node->parent->left = node->left;
            node->left->parent = node->parent;
        } else {
            node->parent->right = node->left;
            node->left->parent = node->parent;
        }
        TreeNode* bk = node->left->right;
        node->left->right = node;
        node->parent = node->left;
        node->left = bk;
        if (bk) bk->parent = node;
        node->height = max(getHeight(node->left), getHeight(node->right)) + 1;
        node->num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(node->left) + getNumTotal(node->right);
        node->num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(node->left);
    }
    
    void rotateLeft(TreeNode* node) {
        if (!node->parent) {
            _tree = node->right;
            node->right->parent = nullptr;
        } else if (isLeft(node)) {
            node->parent->left = node->right;
            node->right->parent = node->parent;
        } else {
            node->parent->right = node->right;
            node->right->parent = node->parent;
        }
        TreeNode* bk = node->right->left;
        node->right->left = node;
        node->parent = node->right;
        node->right = bk;
        if (bk) bk->parent = node;
        node->height = max(getHeight(node->left), getHeight(node->right)) + 1;
        node->num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(node->left) + getNumTotal(node->right);
        node->num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(node->left);
    }
    
    void rebalance(TreeNode* node) {
        TreeNode* n = node;
        while (n) {
            int lh = getHeight(n->left);
            int rh = getHeight(n->right);
            n->height = max(lh, rh) + 1;
            int balanceFactor = lh - rh;
            n->num_total = 1 + getNumTotal(n->left) + getNumTotal(n->right);
            n->num_left = 1 + getNumTotal(n->left);
            
            if (balanceFactor > 1) {
                if (getHeight(n->left->left) < getHeight(n->left->right)) {
                    rotateLeft(n->left);
                }
                rotateRight(n);
            } else if (balanceFactor < -1) {
                if (getHeight(n->right->right) < getHeight(n->right->left)) {
                    rotateRight(n->right);
                }
                rotateLeft(n);
            } else {
                n = n->parent;
            }
        }
    }
    
    TreeNode* add(int k, int v) {
        if (!_tree) {
            _tree = new TreeNode(k, v);
            return _tree;
        }
        TreeNode* node = _tree;
        while (node) {
            if (k < node->key) {
                if (node->left) {
                    node = node->left;
                } else {
                    node->left = new TreeNode(k, v);
                    node->left->parent = node;
                    return node->left;
                }
            } else if (node->key < k) {
                if (node->right) {
                    node = node->right;
                } else {
                    node->right = new TreeNode(k, v);
                    node->right->parent = node;
                    return node->right;
                }
            } else {
                node->value = v;
                return node;
            }
        }
        return nullptr;
    }
    
    TreeNode* getNode(int k) {
        if (!_tree) return nullptr;
        TreeNode* node = _tree;
        while (node) {
            if (k < node->key) {
                node = node->left;
            } else if (node->key < k) {
                node = node->right;
            } else {
                return node;
            }
        }
        return nullptr;
    }
    
    void removeLeaf(TreeNode* node) {
        if (node->parent) {
            if (isLeft(node)) {
                node->parent->left = nullptr;
            } else {
                node->parent->right = nullptr;
            }
            rebalance(node->parent);
        } else {
            _tree = nullptr;
        }
        delete node;
    }
    
    void removeOne(TreeNode* node) {
        TreeNode* replacement = node->left ? node->left : node->right;
        if (node->parent) {
            if (isLeft(node)) {
                node->parent->left = replacement;
            } else {
                node->parent->right = replacement;
            }
            if (replacement) replacement->parent = node->parent;
        } else {
            _tree = replacement;
            if (replacement) replacement->parent = nullptr;
        }
        delete node;
        if (replacement) rebalance(replacement);
    }
    
public:
    AvlTree() : _tree(nullptr) {}
    
    void add(int k, int v) {
        TreeNode* node = add(k, v);
        if (node) rebalance(node);
    }
    
    void removeKey(int k) {
        TreeNode* node = getNode(k);
        if (!node) return;
        if (isLeaf(node)) {
            removeLeaf(node);
            return;
        }
        if (node->left && node->right) {
            TreeNode* nxt = getNext(node);
            node->key = nxt->key;
            node->value = nxt->value;
            if (isLeaf(nxt)) {
                removeLeaf(nxt);
            } else {
                removeOne(nxt);
            }
            rebalance(node);
        } else {
            removeOne(node);
        }
    }
    
    int get(int k) {
        TreeNode* node = getNode(k);
        return node ? node->value : -1;
    }
    
    pair<int, int> getAt(int pos) {
        int x = pos + 1;
        TreeNode* node = _tree;
        while (node) {
            if (x < node->num_left) {
                node = node->left;
            } else if (node->num_left < x) {
                x -= node->num_left;
                node = node->right;
            } else {
                return make_pair(node->key, node->value);
            }
        }
        throw out_of_range("Out of range");
    }
};

// Segment Tree implementation
template<typename T>
class SegmentTree {
private:
    T _default;
    function<T(T, T)> _func;
    int _len;
    int _size;
    vector<T> data;
    
public:
    SegmentTree(const vector<T>& data_init, T default_val, function<T(T, T)> func)
        : _default(default_val), _func(func), _len(data_init.size()) {
        _size = 1;
        while (_size < _len) _size <<= 1;
        data.resize(2 * _size, _default);
        for (int i = 0; i < _len; ++i) {
            data[_size + i] = data_init[i];
        }
        for (int i = _size - 1; i > 0; --i) {
            data[i] = _func(data[2 * i], data[2 * i + 1]);
        }
    }
    
    T query(int start, int stop) {
        if (start == stop) return data[_size + start];
        stop += 1;
        start += _size;
        stop += _size;
        
        T res = _default;
        while (start < stop) {
            if (start & 1) {
                res = _func(res, data[start]);
                start += 1;
            }
            if (stop & 1) {
                stop -= 1;
                res = _func(res, data[stop]);
            }
            start >>= 1;
            stop >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

// Binary search count
int binarySearchCount(const vector<int>& arr, int n, int key) {
    int left = 0, right = n - 1;
    int count = 0;
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = (right + left) / 2;
        if (arr[mid] <= key) {
            count = mid + 1;
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

        l[i] = readInt() % k;

    if (n == 1) {
        printInt(l[0]);
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<int> l1(l.begin(), l.begin() + n/2);
    vector<int> l2(l.begin() + n/2, l.end());
    
    set<int> s, s1, s2;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; ++i) {
        set<int> temp;
        for (int val : s) {
            temp.insert((val + l1[i]) % k);
        }
        for (int val : temp) {
            s.insert(val);
        }
        s.insert(l1[i]);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n - n/2; ++i) {
        set<int> temp;
        for (int val : s1) {
            temp.insert((val + l2[i]) % k);
        }
        for (int val : temp) {
            s1.insert(val);
        }
        s1.insert(l2[i]);
    }
    
    vector<int> sv(s.begin(), s.end());
    vector<int> s1v(s1.begin(), s1.end());
    
    sort(sv.begin(), sv.end());
    sort(s1v.begin(), s1v.end());
    
    int ans = max(sv.empty() ? 0 : sv.back(), s1v.empty() ? 0 : s1v.back());
    
    for (int i = 0; i < sv.size(); ++i) {
        int t = k - 1 - sv[i];
        int ind = binarySearchCount(s1v, s1v.size(), t);
        if (ind > 0) {
            int r = s1v[ind-1];
            int rt = s1v.back();
            ans = max(ans, max((r + sv[i]) % k, (sv[i] + rt) % k));
        }
    }
    
    printInt(ans);
    
    return 0;
}
